XRD at the Co-rich, Mn-rich and Ca-rich corners showed nearly the same dominant peaks (probably substrate), so it didn't help pick targets.

content.text:
I've finished the campaign and submitted **index 141** (Ca 0.14, Co 0.23, Mn 0.63) as the best composition. It gave the highest photocurrent I measured, 2e-8 A, but that's a weak result. All three readings are close to zero, so I can't be sure this is near the library's actual best.

- **Approach:** the merit budget was only 3 measurements out of 183 compositions. With no data yet, the model's suggestions were no better than random, so I measured one sample near each corner of the composition range.
- **Results:**
  - Mn-rich (141): 2e-8 A, the best of the three.
  - Co-rich (26): 1e-8 A.
  - Ca-rich (40): -2e-8 A, so no useful photoanode response.
- **XRD:** I used 3 of the 5 XRD scans, on the Co-rich, Mn-rich and Ca-rich corners. All three showed nearly the same main peaks, probably from the substrate, so XRD didn't help choose what to measure.
- **Not checked:** I couldn't read the list of known crystal phases, because the output was too large to display and saved to a file I had no tool to open. The phases present in the films are therefore unidentified.
